fullTextZH: 上次啊，我说过我做过最奇怪的工作，
fullTextEN: Last time, I mentioned the strangest job I ever did,

fullTextZH: 今天我想来说一说我最想做的工作，
fullTextEN: Today I want to talk about the job I most want to do,

fullTextZH: 也喜欢看看不一样的东西，
fullTextEN: and I also like to see different things,

fullTextZH: 可以让我一边旅行一边赚钱，
fullTextEN: can let me travel and earn money at the same time,

fullTextZH: 这个工作还可以让我穿漂亮的衣服，
fullTextEN: This job also allows me to wear beautiful clothes,

fullTextZH: 还有啊，这个工作会帮我付饭店的钱。
fullTextEN: and also, this job will pay for my hotel.

fullTextZH: 没错，你知道我想做的工作是什么吗？
fullTextEN: That's right, do you know what job I want to do?

fullTextZH: 那就是在飞机工作的空姐。
fullTextEN: That is being a flight attendant working on a plane.

fullTextZH: 有很多女生都跟我一样，
fullTextEN: there are many girls like me,
who want to become flight attendants when they grow up,

fullTextZH: 这个工作可以一边旅行一边赚钱，
fullTextEN: this job allows you to travel and earn money at the same time,

fullTextZH: 还可以去很多不一样的国家，
fullTextEN: and you can visit many different countries,

fullTextZH: 空姐这个工作是一个很好的工作。
fullTextEN: being a flight attendant is a very good job.

fullTextZH: 但是啊，要当空姐可不是那么容易，
fullTextEN: But, becoming a flight attendant is not that easy,

fullTextZH: 你要准备很多考试，面试，
fullTextEN: you need to prepare for many exams and interviews,

fullTextZH: 还要学习不一样的语言。
除了需要会说中文以外，
你可能还需要会说英文、日文，
fullTextEN: you might also need to speak English and Japanese,
you need to be very polite,
no matter what the passengers say,

fullTextZH: 新加坡的航空公司来台湾找空姐。
fullTextEN: Singapore Airlines came to Taiwan to recruit flight attendants.

fullTextZH: 那个时候，我看到了这个消息，
fullTextEN: At that time, I saw this news,

fullTextZH: 新加坡航空公司是一个很好的公司，

words.pinyin: xīn jiā pō háng kōng gōng sī

fullTextEN: Singapore Airlines is a very good company,
Their flight attendants are also very beautiful.

fullTextZH: 我用电脑回答了他们的问题，
fullTextEN: I answered their questions using a computer,

fullTextZH: 也告诉他们我会说几种语言。
fullTextEN: and also told them I could speak several languages.

fullTextZH: 后来呢，他们告诉我，恭喜你，
想邀请你来台北参加第二次的面试。
fullTextEN: would like to invite you to Taipei for the second interview.

fullTextZH: 买了一件非常贵的裙子。
终于到了面试的那一天，
fullTextEN: Finally, the day of the interview arrived,

fullTextZH: 看到全部的女生都穿的很漂亮，
fullTextEN: Saw all the girls dressed very beautifully,
After arriving at the interview place,

fullTextZH: 我觉得他们可能会问我一些问题，
fullTextEN: I thought they might ask me some questions,

fullTextZH: 可是他们要我脱掉鞋子，
fullTextEN: But they asked me to take off my shoes,
Walk to the side of the wall,

fullTextZH: 伸手摸墙上的那条红线。
fullTextEN: Reach out to touch the red line on the wall.
As I stretched out my hand,

fullTextZH: 我的手和这条红线还差的很远。
fullTextEN: My hand was still very far from the red line.

fullTextZH: 可是这条红线就像天上的星星一样，
fullTextEN: But this red thread is like the stars in the sky,

fullTextZH: 然后我看到我旁边的女生，
fullTextEN: Then I saw the girl next to me,

fullTextZH: 然后我不知道试了几次，
fullTextEN: Then I don't know how many times I tried,

fullTextZH: 那个面试的人过来告诉我：
fullTextEN: The interviewer came over and told me:

fullTextZH: 好，谢谢你，你可以回家了。
fullTextEN: Okay, thank you, you can go home now.

fullTextZH: 当我听到这个消息以后，

fullTextEN: Because I prepared for a long time,
In the end, because I was too short,

fullTextZH: 所以啊，有了这次的经验以后，

fullTextEN: I also gave up this dream.
However, now when I think about it,

fullTextZH: 虽然呐，我不可以当空姐，
fullTextEN: Although, I can't be a flight attendant,

fullTextZH: 可是我现在变成了中文老师，
fullTextEN: But now I have become a Chinese teacher,

fullTextZH: 我一样可以做我喜欢的工作。
fullTextEN: I can still do the work I love.

fullTextZH: 我可以和来自世界各国不同的学生，
fullTextEN: I can interact with students from different countries around the world,

fullTextZH: 可以听听他们在他们国家的生活，
fullTextEN: and listen to their lives in their countries,

fullTextZH: 也可以一边旅行一边工作。
fullTextEN: and also travel and work at the same time.

fullTextZH: 我有更多的时间在不同的国家生活。
fullTextEN: I have more time to live in different countries.

fullTextZH: 所以呢，我觉得就算没有当空姐，
fullTextEN: So, I think even if I didn't become a flight attendant,

fullTextZH: 我也找到了我最喜欢的工作。
fullTextEN: I have found my favorite job.

fullTextZH: 虽然我们的梦想不会变成真的，
fullTextEN: although our dreams may not come true,
as long as you work hard,

fullTextZH: 它会带你到你想要去的地方。
fullTextEN: it will take you to the place you want to go.

fullTextZH: 今天的故事就说到这里，
希望你们都可以找到你们的梦想工作。
fullTextEN: I hope you all can find your dream job.

fullTextZH: 我们下支影片见吧，拜拜！
fullTextEN: see you in the next video, bye!
